clips.title: The story
paras: Jannok Breezesong sends promising rogues from Teldrassil to Darnassus. At the Cenarion Enclave, Erion Shadewhisper points them toward work beyond the forests.

Jannok Breezesong sends you from Teldrassil to find Erion Shadewhisper in Darnassus. You need not worry about being sent to the exacting trainer Syurna. Erion waits in the Cenarion Enclave, where he handles work that calls for a quieter touch.

Erion Shadewhisper marks a change for rogues in night elf lands. Teldrassil's forests can no longer contain your duties. Erion sends capable hands into a wider, more dangerous world, toward work across the sea.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do not worry, I am not sending you to see Syurna. Erion requires your presence at the Cenarion Enclave. Make haste!

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is time to branch out, traveler - the world awaits.
